tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List destinations (countries and multi-country regions) with eSIM plans on shibaSIM: code, name, ISO country codes covered, plan count and cheapest USD price.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search shibaSIM travel eSIM plans for one destination with factual filters. Prices are USD. Each result has a checkout_url that sends the buyer to shibaSIM. Per-day plans are filtered on GB/day, fixed plans on total GB.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Full details of one plan by id (from search_plans): data, validity, daily cap and reduced speed, covered countries, hotspot, top-up availability, verified network facts, USD price and checkout_url.
